'''Ernesto Laura''' (23 March 1879 – 29 December 1949) was an Italian [[mathematician]] born in [[Porto Maurizio]].<ref>
[http://mathematica.sns.it/autori/1041/ An Italian short biography of Ernesto Laura] in ''Edizione Nazionale Mathematica Italiana online''.</ref><ref>
{{Citation

|volume =5

|pages =398–400

</ref>

==Biography==
He graduated in [[mathematics]] in 1901 at the [[University of Turin]], where he was a student of [[Giacinto Morera|Morera]] and of [[Carlo Somigliana|Somigliana]].

He taught [[Classical mechanics|rational mechanics]] at the [[University of Messina|Universities of Messina]], [[University of Pavia|Pavia]] and [[University of Padua|Padua]].

Laura has dealt with uncommon elasticity problems, namely related to indefinitely extended elastic means and, especially in the last part of his University career, the mechanics of flexible and inextensible surfaces.
